## Posted terms
Title: AI Training, Learning & Development Specialist
Duration: 12+ Months
Location: New York, NY (Hybrid x3/week)
Rate: not stated

## Job description (as posted)

**Position Overview**
Responsible for designing, delivering, and supporting generative AI training and enablement programs for employees across the enterprise. Work closely with application administrators to ensure support for tools is provided to all users.

**Required Skills**
- 3-5 years of experience in training, instructional design, adult education, or a related field.
- 1-2 years of hands-on experience administering enterprise AI platforms such as OpenAI or Claude Enterprise.
- Hands-on experience with generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, or similar); experience delivering training on generative AI tools is preferred.
- Strong understanding of enterprise security and compliance practices.
- Proven experience designing and facilitating both live (virtual/in-person) and asynchronous learning programs.
- Working knowledge of adult learning theory and its application to AI-related content.
- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools — specifically Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Outlook.
